exposure: immediate postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD) insertion
cohort: Ninety women who underwent IUCD insertion within 10 minutes of delivery of the placenta at a tertiary care hospital in Haryana, India.
finding: Immediate PPIUCD insertion was associated with a high continuation rate (84.4%) at six months postpartum.
mod_finding: The continuation rate was significantly higher in participants who delivered via cesarean section (93.33%) compared to vaginal delivery (82.67%).
